description: WRITE tool — links the second-store version of an existing Sonar product (e.g. the product already tracks the iOS app and you want to add the Android version, or vice versa). Each product holds at most one iOS + one Android app; to start tracking a brand-new app, use sonar_create_product instead. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "us"). Optional — defaults server-side.

product_id.description: Sonar product UUID (from sonar_create_product). NOT a store id.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier of the version to link. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name: sonar_track_app
title: Track App
